text:
alex: Quick Q — where's the easiest saved search to hunt logs by org/model/route+region? Trying to investigate a spike in 5xx for ACME gen route in EU.

priya: There's a saved view under LogSearch: "acme/eu/gen-route-5xx". Saved Views -> org=acme. Link: https://logsearch.redwood/investigate/views/12345

sasha: If you want the raw query to paste:
```
org_id:acme AND model:"gpt-4o-redwood" AND route:"/v1/generate" AND region:eu-west-1 AND status:[500 TO 599]
```
Add `@timestamp:[now-15m TO now]` for last 15m window.

marta: Also group by `route, model` and do a count histogram to see bursts. Dash with hist: https://console.redwood/dashboards/metrics/gen-route-hist

alex: Thanks! Can someone save that exact query as a reusable saved search? I'd like to attach it to an alert and the runbook.

sasha: I'll create it as `acme-eu-gen-5xx` and share the ID. Give me ~10m.

infra-bot: Saved view created by sasha: acme-eu-gen-5xx (id:9876)

priya: For alert thresholds I'd start with either: "5xx rate > 0.8% over 5m" (rate-normalized) or "absolute errors > 50 in 5m" (absolute). Use both — rate for regressions, absolute to avoid noisy small-traffic signals.

alex: Which alert policy should I attach to? `app-prod-errors` or `gen-route-slo`?

marta: Attach primary to `app-prod-errors`. Add a secondary quick alert that pages when absolute >50 and label it `gen-route-absolutes`. I'll update the runbook with links to the saved view and dashboard.

sasha: Saved search link: https://logsearch.redwood/views/9876 — adding it to `app-prod-errors` now :thumbsup:

alex: Perfect. After it's hooked up, can someone add the route+model filter to the rollout dashboard so I can compare pre/post deploys?

priya: Will add the filter to `/dashboards/rollouts` and tag the runbook. Ping me if you need canary filters (`route:/v1/generate AND model:gpt-4o-redwood AND tag:canary`).

deploy-bot: Deploy completed: canary v2026.3 -> eu-west-1 (sasha) :rocket:

alex: Thanks all — I'll watch alerts. If anyone sees sustained 5xx > threshold, escalate to oncall and drop notes in #incidents.
